The '''homeworld''' of [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], this [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was a war-torn place. The population of the planet were engaged in [[Ground warfare/Legends|trench warfare]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and Kota saw combat from the age of ten. Eventually, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] arrived on the planet to negotiate a peaceful end to the fighting. During his [[Time/Legends|time]] of the planet, he discovered Kota's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitivity]], and took him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a Jedi. Kota was eighteen at the time.<ref name="TFUdb">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed#The Force Unleashed Databank|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game Databank]]</ref>
